

```{r}
set.seed(1)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(gridExtra)
library(mirt)

th=sort(rnorm(1000))
n_i=100 # Number of Items
bs<-data.frame(b1=0, b2=sort(c(runif(n_i-5, min=0.1, max=3), 0, 0.1, 1.4, 2, 3 )) )
bs.c<-data.frame(b1=0, b2=sort(c(runif(n_i-3, min=-3, max=3), -3, 0,3 )) ) 
a_i<-sort(c(runif(n_i-6, min=0.1, max=3), 0, 0.14, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 3) )
a=1

### Simulate GRM

simgrm<-function(th,b,a) {
  invlogit<-function(z) 1/(1+exp(-z))
  K<-length(b)+1
  pr<-list()
  for (i in 1:(K-1)) pr[[i]]<-invlogit(a*(th-b[i]))
  pr<-do.call("cbind",pr)
  pr<-cbind(1,pr,0)
  p<-list()
  for (i in 1:K) p[[i]]<-pr[,i]-pr[,i+1]
  p<-do.call("cbind",p)
  colnames(p)<-paste("truep",0:(ncol(p)-1),sep='')
  resp<-numeric()
  for (i in 1:length(th)) resp[i]<-which(rmultinom(1,1,p[i,])[,1]>0)-1
  id=1:length(th)
  data.frame(cbind(id, th.true=th, p, resp))
}

### Simulate NRM
simnrm<-function(th, c, a) {
  K<-length(a)
  z<-list()
  for (k in 1:K) {
    kern<-a[k]*th+c[k]
    z[[k]]<-exp(kern)
  }
  z<-do.call("cbind", z)
  den<-rowSums(z)
  p<-z/den
  colnames(p)<-paste("truep",0:(ncol(p)-1), sep='')
  resp<-numeric()
  for (i in 1:length(th)) resp[i]<-which(rmultinom(1, 1, p[i,])[,1]>0)-1
  id=1:length(th)
  data.frame(cbind(id, th.true=th, p, resp))
}

### Simulate GPCM
simpcm<-function(th,b,a) {
  K<-length(b)+1
  psi<-list()
  psi[[1]]<-rep(1,length(th))
  for (k in 1:(K-1)) {
    kern<-k*th-sum(b[1:k])
    psi[[k+1]]<-exp(a*kern)
  }
  psi<-do.call("cbind",psi)
  den<-rowSums(psi)
  p<-psi/den
  colnames(p)<-paste("truep",0:(ncol(p)-1),sep='')
  resp<-numeric()
  for (i in 1:length(th)) resp[i]<-which(rmultinom(1,1,p[i,])[,1]>0)-1
  id=1:length(th)
  data.frame(cbind(id, th.true=th, p, resp))
}

# Simulate three GRM one constant

simgrm.const<-function(th,b,a) {
  invlogit<-function(z) 1/(1+exp(-z))
  K<-length(b)+1
  pr<-list()
  for (i in 1:(K-1)) pr[[i]]<-invlogit(a*(th-b[i]))
  pr<-do.call("cbind",pr)
  pr<-cbind(1,pr,0)
  p<-list()
  for (i in 1:K) p[[i]]<-(pr[,i]-pr[,i+1])*0.75
  p[[K+1]]=0.25
  p<-do.call("cbind",p)
  colnames(p)<-paste("truep",0:(ncol(p)-1),sep='')
  resp<-numeric()
  rowSums(p)
  for (i in 1:length(th)) resp[i]<-which(rmultinom(1,1,p[i,])[,1]>0)-1
  id=1:length(th)
  data.frame(cbind(id, th.true=th, p, resp))
}

# Given list of item dataframes separate item responses
resp_th= function(list){
  df=data.frame(th)
  for (i in 1:length(list)){
    df[[i+1]]<-list[[i]][, ncol(list[[i]])]
  }
  colnames(df)<-c("th", paste("Item", 1:(length(list)),sep='') )
  df
}
```

```{r}
# a2 Parameter Constraints
constraint2<-function(n_i){
  k=3
  y=data.frame()
  library(dplyr)
  for (i in 1:n_i){
    s<-rep(c(rep(1/k, k-1) , ((1/k)-1) ), k-1)
    T_mat=matrix(s, ncol=k-1, byrow=TRUE)
    random_n<-matrix(c(runif(1, min=0, max=1.5), runif(1, min=1.5, max=3)), ncol=1)
    m=sort(T_mat%*%random_n)
    df<-data.frame(a1=m[1], a2=m[2], a3=m[3])
    y<-rbind(y, df)
  }
  y<-y %>% arrange(a1)
}
as<-constraint2(n_i)
c=c(-1, 0, 1)

# a2 varies
c<-c(0, 1, 2 )
all.a2.val<-data.frame(a1=0, a2=sort( c(runif(n_i-3, min=-3, max=3), -2, 1, 3 )), a3=2 )
all.a2=list()
for (i in 1:n_i){
  df.nrm1=list(simnrm(th, c=c, a=as.numeric(all.a2.val[i,])))
  all.a2[i]=df.nrm1   
}

# c2 varies
as<-c(0, 1, 2)
all.c2.val<-data.frame(c1=0, c2=sort(c( runif(n_i-3, min=-3, max=3), -2, 1, 3 )), c3=2 )

all.c2=list()
for (i in 1:n_i){
  df.nrm1=list(simnrm(th, c=as.numeric(all.c2.val[i,]), a=as ) )
  all.c2[i]=df.nrm1 
}
```

```{r}
est.fun.nom<-function(resp){
  l2=list()
  m <- mirt(resp, 1, itemtype = "nominal") # c(rep("graded", ncol(resp))))
  th<-fscores(m)
  colnames(th)="th"
  for (i in 1:ncol(resp)){
    item<-extract.item(m, i)
    pr<-probtrace(item, th)
    id=1:nrow(resp)
    df=list(cbind(id, th=th, pr, resp[i]))
    l2[i]=df
  }
  l2
}

resp<-resp_th(ordered.grm.a.const)
list.est=est.fun.nom(resp[,-1])
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(gridExtra)
library(mirt)

th=sort(rnorm(1000)) # Number of Respondents
n_i=100 # Number of Items


est.fun.nom<-function(resp){
  l2=list()
  m <- mirt::mirt(resp, 1, itemtype = "nominal") # c(rep("graded", ncol(resp))))
  th<-mirt::fscores(m)
  colnames(th)="th"
  for (i in 1:ncol(resp)){
    item<-mirt::extract.item(m, i)
    pr<-mirt::probtrace(item, th)
    id=1:nrow(resp)
    df=list(cbind(id, th=th, pr, resp[i]))
    l2[i]=df
  }
  l2
}


### Simulate NRM
simnrm<-function(th, c, a) {
  K<-length(a)
  z<-list()
  for (k in 1:K) {
    kern<-a[k]*th+c[k]
    z[[k]]<-exp(kern)
  }
  z<-do.call("cbind", z)
  den<-rowSums(z)
  p<-z/den
  colnames(p)<-paste("truep",0:(ncol(p)-1), sep='')
  resp<-numeric()
  for (i in 1:length(th)) resp[i]<-which(rmultinom(1, 1, p[i,])[,1]>0)-1
  id=1:length(th)
  data.frame(cbind(id, th.true=th, p, resp))
}


# NRM

# a2 Parameter Constraints
constraint2<-function(n_i){
  k=3
  y=data.frame()
  library(dplyr)
  for (i in 1:n_i){
    s<-rep(c(rep(1/k, k-1) , ((1/k)-1) ), k-1)
    T_mat=matrix(s, ncol=k-1, byrow=TRUE)
    random_n<-matrix(c(runif(1, min=0, max=1.5), runif(1, min=1.5, max=3)), ncol=1)
    m=sort(T_mat%*%random_n)
    df<-data.frame(a1=m[1], a2=m[2], a3=m[3])
    y<-rbind(y, df)
  }
  y<-y %>% arrange(a1)
}
as<-constraint2(n_i)

resp_th= function(list){
  df=data.frame(th)
  for (i in 1:length(list)){
    df[[i+1]]<-list[[i]][, ncol(list[[i]])]
  }
  colnames(df)<-c("th", paste("Item", 1:(length(list)),sep='') )
  df
}


# Generate Data when a2 varies
c<-c(0, 1, 2 )
all.a2.val<-data.frame(a1=0, a2=sort( c(runif(n_i-3, min=-3, max=3), -2, 1, 3 )), a3=2 )
all.a2=list()
for (i in 1:n_i){
  df.nrm1=list(simnrm(th, c=c, a=as.numeric(all.a2.val[i,])))
  all.a2[i]=df.nrm1   
}


index5<-function(resp){
  est.nrm<-mirt::mirt(resp, 1, itemtype="nominal")
  par<-data.frame(mirt::coef(est.nrm, IRTpars=TRUE, simplify=TRUE))
  cols <- grep("^items\\.a", names(par), value = TRUE)
  ord <- order(as.numeric(sub("items\\.a", "", cols)))
  itempar.est<-par[, cols[ord]]
  d=list()
  for (i in 1:(length(itempar.est)-1)){
    d[i]<-data.frame(itempar.est[,(i+1)]-itempar.est[,i])
  }
  difference=data.frame(do.call("cbind", d))
  f=list()
  for (i in 1:nrow(difference)){
      zz<-difference[i, ]
      zz<-zz[!is.na(zz)]
      K=length(zz)+1
      len <- 6 / (K - 1)
      if (all(zz > 0)){
          f[i]=sum(as.numeric(zz))/6
      }
      else{ f[i]=mean(as.numeric(zz[which(zz<=0)]))/len}
  }
  ind5=do.call("rbind", f)
  ind5
}

index6<-function(resp){
  ind=as.numeric()
  list=est.fun.nom(resp)
  for (i in 1:length(list)){
    df1=list[[i]]
    th=df1$th
    df=df1[,-c(1, 2, length(df1))]
    cols <- 1:ncol(df)
    pairs <- t(combn(cols, 2))
    results <- numeric()
    for (i in 1:nrow(pairs)) {
      col1 <- pairs[i, 2]
      col2 <- pairs[i, 1]
      value <- mean(diff(df[, col1] / df[, col2]) / diff(th), na.rm = TRUE)
      results <- c(results, value)
    }
    d=atan(results)
    if (all(d > 0)){
      f=mean(as.numeric(d))
    } else{ f=mean(d[which(d<=0)] )}
    ind=rbind(ind, f)
  }
  ind
}

# Compute Index 5 and Index 6 for this data
resp.nrm.a2<-resp_th(all.a2)[,-1]
d06=data.frame(index5(resp.nrm.a2))
d07=data.frame(index6(resp.nrm.a2))

p2=ggplot() + geom_smooth(data=data.frame(all.a2.val, df10=d07[,1]), mapping=aes(x=a2, y=df10, col="Nominal"), size=0.5, span = 0.5, se=F) + theme_classic() +ylab("Order Index 6") + xlab(expression(a[2])) + scale_color_manual(values = colors) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3), breaks = seq(-3, 3, by = 1)) + scale_y_continuous( breaks = seq(-1.5, 1.5, by = 0.5)) + geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dotted", color="blue", size=0.7)+ geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 2, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), alpha = 1/5, fill = "blue")
```
